item.description: Aaron Aguirre-Garay told police he had been drinking earlier that day but didn't clarify exactly how many he consumed. He denied a field sobriety test and a blood alcohol test.

item.title: Team USA vs. Canada hockey rivalry gives Olympics boost of best on best | Renck & File
item.description: Canada needs this more than the U.S. The Americans are underdogs with attitude, a team capable of winning, but failure will not define them like, say, a Super Bowl. That is what this is for Canada.

item.title: Nikola Jokic wrist injury: Wrap comes off as Nuggets bounce back in win at Blazers
item.description: In a Nuggets rout of Portland, Nikola Jokic played perhaps his most dominant game since returning from a knee injury three weeks. While he's struggled, he's also dealt with right wrist pain.
